verdict.rationale: Privacy posture is a fair question for a real-time video and voice AI platform like Daily. However, the evidence pack contains no documented AI-training opt-out, no no-training commitment, and no data-use policy covering model training. Related privacy controls (end-to-end encryption, HIPAA BAAs, the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, recordings stored in your own bucket) are adjacent features and do not show that customer data is excluded from AI training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
